Douglas County
                                      Planning Commission
                                    Public Meeting Notice
                                         and Agenda
                                         UPDATED
 Tuesday, October 13, 2026                        1:00 PM                              Historic Courthouse
                                                                                        1616 Eighth Street
                                                                                     Minden, Nevada 89423

 The Planning Commission may also be meeting for lunch on the same day, at 11:30 a.m. at Cook'd,
 1644 US Hwy 395 N, Minden, NV. Members of the public, press, and staff are welcome. This is a
 social gathering and no Planning Commission business will be discussed.

 To watch the meeting:
 Members of the public may click on the following link to watch the livestream of the Planning
 Commission meeting:
 https://www.youtube.com/@douglascountynevada/streams

 Written public comment:
 To offer public comment before the meeting, members of the public may submit public comments by
 email to planning@douglasnv.us. Please make sure to state your name, item number and position on
 the item.

 All written public comments that are received prior to 4:00 PM the day before the meeting will be
 compiled and added as supplemental material for the Planning Commissioners and the public to review
 prior to the meeting.

 Public comment during the meeting:
 In person: Members of the public may attend the meeting in person.

 Members of the public may call the Planning Department at 775-782-6200, Option 4, to
 obtain help making public comment prior to the meeting.

 Members of the public may request an electronic copy of the agenda or the supporting materials by
 contacting the planning division (Coleen Zepeda) at 775- 782-6200, Option 4, or by email
 planning@douglasnv.us. Electronic copies of the agenda and supporting materials are also available
 at the following websites:

    • State of Nevada Public Notices website: https://notice.nv.gov/
    • Douglas County Meeting website:
 https://douglascountynv.granicus.com/ViewPublisher.php? view_id=1

 A copy of the finalized public notice and agenda is posted at the Minden Inn at 1594
 Esmeralda Avenue, Minden Nevada

 It is the intent of the Planning Commission to protect the dignity of citizens who wish to comment before
 the Commission. It is also the members' wish to provide the citizens of Douglas County with an

Douglas County Planning Commission                                                          October 13, 2026
                                                                                                           1

environment that upholds the highest professional standards. Citizens should have the ability to
 freely comment on items and/or projects that are brought before the Commission for action without
 interference.

 Notice to Persons with Disabilities: Members of the public who are disabled or require special
 assistance or accommodations are requested to notify the Planning Department in writing at P.O. Box
 218, Minden, Nevada 89423 or by calling 782-6217 at least 20 hours in advance.




Douglas County Planning Commission                                                    October 13, 2026
                                                                                                     2

DOUGLAS COUNTY PLANNING COMMISSION

                                             FINAL AGENDA

                                              October 13, 2026

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 OPENING PUBLIC COMMENT (NO ACTION)
 Public comment is limited to three minutes per speaker on matters over which the Planning
 Commission has jurisdiction, supervision or control. The Planning Commission wants to encourage the
 respectful consideration of all views by members of the public. If the content is willfully disruptive of
 the meeting by being irrelevant, repetitious, slanderous, offensive, inflammatory, irrational, or amounts
 to a personal attack or interfering with the rights of others, the individual will be asked to stop speaking.

 In addition to opening public comment, public comment will also be taken on public hearing agenda
 items that are identified for possible action and closing public comment. If you plan to speak on a
 specific agenda item that is on the Public Hearing agenda and identified for possible action, then please
 provide your public comment when that agenda item is heard.

 At this time, public comment will be taken on those items that are within the jurisdiction and control of
 the Planning Commission. Additional public comment periods may be allowed on individual agenda
 items at the discretion of the Chairperson. It is requested that members of the public comment on those
 agenda items when they are considered.
 APPROVAL OF AGENDA

 For possible action. Approval of proposed agenda. The Planning Commission reserves the right to take
 items in a different order; to combine two or more agenda items for consideration; and to remove items
 from the agenda or delay discussion relating to an item on the agenda at any time.

 APPROVAL OF MINUTES

      For possible action. Discussion to approve the draft minutes of the August 11, 2026 meeting of the
      Planning Commission.
 PUBLIC HEARINGS

      1.   For possible action. Discussion on Ordinance 2026-1673, a Zoning Text Amendment
           amending Douglas County Code, Title 20, by revising section 20.664.125 to add an
           affordable housing exemption to the commercial floor area requirement applicable to multi-
           family housing that requires a mixed-use component.

      2.  For possible action. Discussion on Ordinance 2026-1674, a Zoning Text Amendment
          amending Douglas County Code, Title 20, by revising Chapter 20.440, adding definitions
          applicable to the Chapter, revising the conditions that apply to density bonus and affordable
          housing agreements, and modifying the findings required for approval of such agreements.
                                                                                        October 13, 2026
Douglas County Planning Commission                                                                      3

3.   For possible action: Discussion on Ordinance 2026-1676, an Ordinance repealing and
           replacing the entirety of Douglas County Code, Title 20, the Douglas County Development
           Code, by enacting a new Development Code that provides a new format, updates definitions,
           clarifies prior code discrepancies, eliminates outdated and unused zoning districts, and
           addresses other properly related matters. The Ordinance is being proposed by the Douglas
           County Community Development Department, based on significant public feedback and
           outreach. (Kate Moroles-O’Neil, Tom Dallaire, & Andrea Pawling, Community
           Development Department, and AnnMarie Lain, NCE) The County is going to request a
           continuance for this item. Staff will be requesting a continuance for this item.

      4.   For possible action: Discussion to approve, conditionally approve, deny or continue Major
           Design Review application DP26-0042 for a 100-foot (monopole) cell tower and associated
           antennas, as well as support equipment and an emergency backup generator within a 30-foot
           by 30-foot fenced equipment area. The subject property is located along State Route 88, in
           Minden, NV, south of the Carson Valley Swim Center, in the A-19 zoning district, within the
           south sub-area of the Agricultural Community Plan. The applicant is Melissa Ofina of Epic
           Wireless on behalf of Verizon Wireless. The property owner is the Patricia L. Rand 2003
           Trust. APN: 1320-31-000-016
 CLOSING PUBLIC COMMENT (NO ACTION)

 At this time, public comment will be taken on those items that are within the jurisdiction and control of
 the Planning Commission or those agenda items where public comment has not already been taken.

 ADJOURNMENT
